snippet.title: Schrödinger's Call -  Official Trailer 2
snippet.description:
Mary, the protagonist, has lost all her memories. She finds herself in an unfamiliar dark room with only a phone and a notebook. The phone rings. After a conversation with "Wandering souls," a stranger appears on the other side of the line. A cat says, "If you save her, you will be saved too." Thus begins an emotional adventure using a phone and a notebook.


Studio: Acrobatic Chirimenjako

Genre: A Last Phone Call Adventure
